verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag platform, so OpenFeature provider support is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions OpenFeature or any vendor-neutral provider. The React 'StatsigProvider' component and the HTTP API are Statsig-specific interfaces, not OpenFeature providers, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
